Subject: Management response and evidence for SOC 2 exception (Oct 2025) — FinTechX

Hi Elena / Crowe team,

Thanks for raising this. Per our internal review, please find the following for the Oct 2025 exception noted in section 4.2:  

1) Management response (attached): Redwood acknowledges a lapse in the quarterly access recertification process during Oct 2025 due to an assignment configuration gap. Root cause and corrective actions are described; compensating controls were in effect.  
2) Evidence attachments:  
   - auth_review_log_extract.csv — filtered extract showing the Oct 2025 reviewer entries and subsequent reassignments.  
   - evidence_network_diagram.png — environment diagram for context.  
3) Remediation completed:  
   - Re-run recertification: 2025-11-02 (records included in CSV).  
   - Automated reminders enabled and owner reassigned: 2025-11-10.  

We have also attached a proposed bridge letter template; if that suits your governance needs we can execute (DocuSign link below). If Crowe needs extended attestation language, let us know the specific phrasing and we'll adapt.

DocuSign (bridge letter): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-FTX-2026
Drive (evidence): https://drive.google.com/fintechx/soc2-evidence

Requested next steps:  
- Confirm whether the attached CSV and attestation meet FinTechX's evidence requirements by 11/12 for your governance call.  
- If not, specify items needed (e.g., audit log extract for a particular IAM service or signature from Compliance).

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec — Strategic Sales
